name: Identity and Access
responsibility: Registration, login, refresh, logout, role and account-state enforcement.

name: Skill Passport
responsibility: Canonical skills, aliases and candidate evidence.

name: Protected CV and CV Studio
responsibility: Private upload, scan, controlled streaming and deterministic template rendering.

name: Company Trust
responsibility: Complete company legal profile, protected evidence package, submission, administrator review, correction/resubmission, verification projection, suspension and re-verification.

name: Vacancy Lifecycle
responsibility: Draft, moderation, activation, closure and expiry.

name: Search and Discovery
responsibility: Trusted public vacancy search and candidate projections.

name: Matching Engine
responsibility: RM-1.0 deterministic scoring, gaps, receipts and replay.

name: Applications
responsibility: Idempotent duplicate-safe apply, history and withdrawal.

name: Employer Applicant Review
responsibility: Stable ranking, evidence review and protected CV access.

name: Application Status
responsibility: Allowed transition matrix, history and notifications.

name: Consent Contact
responsibility: One pending request, candidate decision, conditional detail release.

name: Notifications
responsibility: Owner-only in-app inbox and durable outbox delivery.

name: Reporting and Audit
responsibility: Truth-based summaries, exports and append-only audit.

name: Administration and Governance
responsibility: Verification, users, moderation, skill governance and locked settings.
